note: Facts transcribed from each provider's public API reference (chatReferenceUrl). Used for upstream URL, unsupported-parameter and usage expectations where no machine-readable spec exists. Re-check against the URL before relying on an entry.

openai.notes: Official openai/openai-openapi repo (default branch main, last commit 2026-10-17). Server https://api.openai.com/v1. A JSON twin is at .../main/openapi.json. /chat/completions also has GET (list stored completions).

azure.notes: Azure OpenAI v1 GA data-plane spec (TypeSpec-generated, OpenAPI 3.2.0). Server is {endpoint}/openai/v1, i.e. https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1; model is the deployment name in the body. The older dated /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/chat/completions?api-version=... surface lives in specification/cognitiveservices/data-plane/AzureOpenAI/inference (path not re-verified here; the stable/2024-10-21 path returned 404). Note OpenAPI 3.2.0 may not be accepted by older validators.

anthropic.notes: Stainless "documented" spec, served live by app.stainless.com (current). Beta variants are separate paths suffixed ?beta=true. Server https://api.anthropic.com.

amazon-bedrock.streamUsage: Not documented on the Chat Completions page (stream: true shown, usage not described).
amazon-bedrock.notes: Chat Completions page defers to the OpenAI reference ("For complete API details, see the OpenAI Chat Completions documentation"). bedrock-runtime is now the recommended endpoint; mantle is "compatibility". Path prefix on mantle varies per model (/v1 vs /openai/v1); check the model card. Responses API exists on both endpoints for some models (GPT OSS on bedrock-runtime: Chat Completions only). Claude on InvokeModel (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-parameters-anthropic-claude-messages-request-response.html): body fields anthropic_version ("bedrock-2023-05-31", required), anthropic_beta (string[]), max_tokens (required), system, messages, temperature, top_p, top_k, tools, tool_choice {type: any|auto|tool, name}, stop_sequences, output_config.effort (beta header effort-2025-11-24); no model or stream field in the body (model is the path, streaming is InvokeModelWithResponseStream). Response usage shown as input_tokens/output_tokens only on that page (cache fields not documented there). stop_reason values: end_turn, max_tokens, stop_sequence, refusal (with stop_details), tool_use, model_context_window_exceeded.

google-ai-studio.streamUsage: Not stated; an example passes stream_options.include_usage=true and reads chunk.usage.
google-ai-studio.notes: Compatibility layer is described as beta. Params list above is only what examples use; no full list. reasoning_effort mapping: minimal/low/medium/high to thinking levels (Gemini 3+) or budgets 1024/1024/8192/24576 (2.5); "none" disables thinking on 2.5 only. Python examples nest extra_body inconsistently (extra_body={"extra_body":{"google":...}}).

google-vertex.baseUrl: https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/endpoints/openapi (path ends /chat/completions); base URL not stated on the overview page itself
unsupportedOpenAIParams: Any parameter not listed is ignored (page: "If you pass any unsupported parameter, it is ignored")
google-vertex.streamUsage: Not documented on the overview page.
google-vertex.notes: response_format: json_object -> application/json, json_schema supported except fully recursive schemas, text -> text/plain. tool_choice: none, auto, required (ANY), validated. reasoning_effort low/medium/high -> 1024/8192/24576 thinking tokens. Tool parameters use the OpenAPI schema subset, not full JSON Schema. Supported Google models listed: Gemini 4 Argon family; self-deployed TGI/vLLM models also use this layer.

spacex-ai.notes: Same file is served at https://api.x.ai/api-docs/openapi.json and https://docs.x.ai/api/openapi.json. Server https://api.x.ai.

deepseek.baseUrl: https://api.deepseek.com (beta features: https://api.deepseek.com/beta). Main base URL is not stated on the reference page itself.
unsupportedOpenAIParams: tool_choice required / named function (400 in thinking mode)
deepseek.streamUsage: Final chunk before [DONE] always carries whole-request usage regardless of include_usage; no separate usage-only chunk. With include_usage=true every chunk has usage (null except last); otherwise usage is absent except on the last chunk. stream_options without stream=true returns 400.
deepseek.notes: response_format types: text, json_object. tool_choice: none, auto, required, named function. Models listed: deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro. max_tokens 1-393216. prompt_cache_hit_tokens/miss are top-level in usage in the examples (schema indentation is ambiguous). Docs site uses docusaurus-openapi-docs but no spec download is exposed.

mistral.notes: Served by docs.mistral.ai (current). An older copy exists at raw.githubusercontent.com/mistralai/platform-docs-public/main/openapi.yaml (661 KB, stale). Server https://api.mistral.ai (gateway also uses api.eu.mistral.ai).

cohere.notes: reasoning_effort accepts only none and high (maps to Cohere thinking off/on); low and medium "not supported at this time". Cohere-native params (connectors, documents, citation_options, ...) are not available through this API. System prompts are sent with the developer role. tools[].function.strict supported. Structured output: response_format type json_object plus a schema. The native v2 Chat API has a Fern-based spec, but the gateway uses the compatibility API, which has no machine-readable spec.

groq.notes: Stainless spec URL taken from the last groq/groq-typescript .stats.yml that published one (commit 1df552f, 2026-06-21); newer .stats.yml files omit openapi_spec_url, so this may lag the live API by ~4 months. Server https://api.groq.com.

cerebras.notes: Stainless spec from Cerebras/cerebras-cloud-sdk-node .stats.yml (updated 2026-07-08). Server https://api.cerebras.ai. The docs site also embeds a newer per-operation spec (see additionalSpecs).

together.notes: Served by docs.together.ai (the API reference .md pages cite openapi.yaml). Server https://api.together.ai/v1. No /responses or /messages path in this spec.

fireworks.notes: Stainless spec from fw-ai-external/python-sdk .stats.yml (last updated 2026-05-01; may lag). No servers block; base is https://api.fireworks.ai/inference (chat at https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions). The docs page embeds a newer chat-only spec (additionalSpecs).

deepinfra.notes: Served live by the API host (server https://api.deepinfra.com). The spec lists chat at /v1/chat/completions, but the gateway code references the /v1/openai prefix and the spec has no /v1/openai/chat/completions path (only /v1/openai/videos*). Assumed (unverified) that both prefixes share the same body schema.

perplexity.notes: Stainless spec from perplexityai/perplexity-node .stats.yml on branch next (updated 2026-07-17). Server https://api.perplexity.ai. Note chat is /chat/completions (no /v1) while responses is /v1/responses.

sambanova.notes: Stainless spec from the last SambaNova/sambanova-python .stats.yml that published one (commit 6e9c54e, 2026-06-25). Base https://api.sambanova.ai/v1.

novita.baseUrl: https://api.novita.ai/openai (gateway config); endpoint not stated on the page
novita.streamUsage: With stream_options.include_usage, an extra chunk with empty choices carries usage before [DONE]; other chunks have usage: null.
novita.notes: max_tokens is marked required. response_format types: text, json_object, json_schema. tool_choice not documented. Content parts: text, image_url, video_url, input_audio. Page has range inconsistencies (n "1 < x < 128" with default 1). No machine-readable spec found (no embedded OpenAPI in the .md export).

siliconflow.notes: No standalone spec URL found; the Mintlify .md export of the chat page embeds a single-operation OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (verified: parses, POST /chat/completions). Server https://api.siliconflow.com/v1.

moonshotai.notes: Served from the Kimi platform docs site. Server https://api.moonshot.ai.

minimax.streamUsage: Set stream_options.include_usage=true to receive usage; field names not documented.
minimax.notes: temperature range [0,2], out-of-range errors. Thinking tokens count toward max_tokens. Only "length" finish_reason is mentioned.

z-ai.notes: Served by docs.z.ai. Server https://api.z.ai/api. Coding-plan and Anthropic-compatible endpoints are not in this spec.

alibaba-cloud.baseUrl: https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 (Singapore; also us-east-1, cn-beijing, cn-hongkong, eu-central-1, ap-northeast-1). Legacy https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 still works (gateway uses it).
unsupportedOpenAIParams: tool_choice "required" (Qwen does not support; thinking mode rejects it)
forcing a specific function on thinking models
alibaba-cloud.streamUsage: Only when stream_options.include_usage=true: usage in the final chunk, which has an empty choices array (other chunks usage: null).
alibaba-cloud.notes: Non-OpenAI params go at top level for raw HTTP (extra_body in the Python SDK). response_format: text, json_object (prompt must mention JSON), json_schema. tool_choice: auto (default), none, required, named. parallel_tool_calls defaults to false. reasoning_effort values vary by model (qwen3.8: low/medium/xhigh; DeepSeek-V4 and GLM: high/max). Nesting of cache_creation* fields is ambiguous on the page (listed after prompt_tokens_details). completion_tokens_details.text_tokens includes reasoning tokens. Older page https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/compatibility-of-openai-with-dashscope lists only prompt/completion/total usage and finish_reason null/stop/length. No Responses API statement on either page.

baidu.streamUsage: Not included by default when streaming; include_usage=true puts real usage on the last chunk (others null); chunk_include_usage=true puts cumulative usage on every chunk.
baidu.notes: Page in Chinese. response_format: text, json_object, json_schema. tool_choice: none, auto, required, or {type: function, function: {name}}. stop up to 4 entries of max 20 chars. max_completion_tokens overrides max_tokens; both count reasoning. cached_tokens documented as only for ERNIE-4.0-Turbo-8K. Response may also include search_results, reasoning_content, flag, ban_round.

byteplus.streamUsage: Default: no usage (null) for most models; include_usage=true adds a final chunk with empty choices and whole-request usage before [DONE]; chunk_include_usage=true gives cumulative usage per chunk. Some models (glm-5-2-260617, deepseek-v4-*-ga) return usage by default.
byteplus.notes: Page is client-rendered; content read from the MDContent JSON embedded in the HTML (updated 2026-10-17). response_format types: text, json_schema, json_object. tool_choice: none, auto, required, or named function. Response extras: moderation_hit_type, service_status.model_fallback. A Responses API exists at /api/v3/responses (separate docs, not reviewed).

stepfun.streamUsage: Usage appears in every chunk, cumulative; no stream_options needed.
stepfun.notes: Undocumented (possibly unsupported): stream_options, tool_choice, presence_penalty, logprobs, seed, max_completion_tokens, json_schema. frequency_penalty range 0-1. Defaults temperature 0.5, top_p 0.9. response_format text|json_object. UNCERTAIN cached_tokens nesting: the English reference fetched shows it flat under usage; a search summary of the Chinese reference placed it at usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and mentioned completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens. Intermediate stream chunks use finish_reason "" (empty string), not null.

xiaomi.notes: Only a quick-start page found; params are those used in the examples, not a reference list. Example curl authenticates with an "api-key" header (gateway may use Bearer). Assistant messages carry reasoning_content in thinking mode and docs recommend sending it back in multi-turn tool calls. Thinking on/off parameter is on a separate Deep Thinking guide (not reviewed); third-party guides use extra_body thinking: {type: disabled}. V2.5 model IDs invalid from 2026-10-21.

ai21.notes: FastAPI spec served by the API host (no servers block); base https://api.ai21.com. Also contains many Studio app endpoints.

aion-labs.streamUsage: Final chunk always carries usage; include_usage accepted for compatibility; continuous_usage_stats adds cumulative usage to every chunk.
aion-labs.notes: Recorded from a web-search summary of the official API reference page (not fetched directly); verify before relying on it. reasoning_effort listed for Aion 2.0/3.0/3.0 Mini.

akashml.notes: Served live by the API host. Server https://api.akashml.com.

ambient.notes: Served live by the API host (no servers block; base https://api.ambient.xyz).

arcee-ai.notes: Docs page lacks response_format, stream_options, parallel_tool_calls, max_completion_tokens, reasoning_effort (absent, not stated unsupported). tool_choice string enum auto|none|required. Response note: provider-specific extras are stripped.

atlascloud.streamUsage: Not documented in the text export.
atlascloud.notes: Reference page renders from an internal schema (src/lib/schemas/llm.yaml) that is not publicly downloadable (guessed URLs 404). https://www.atlascloud.ai/docs/llm-protocols lists POST /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/messages and /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent on one base URL; auth via Bearer, x-api-key or x-goog-api-key. Each model publishes supported_apis.

avian.notes: Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list. Recorded from a web-search summary (page not fetched; avian.io/docs/llms.txt is 404).

baseten.notes: Model APIs spec linked from the chat reference page (embedded as reference/inference-api/llm-openapi-spec.json). Server https://inference.baseten.co. Self-deployed models use a different per-deployment base URL.

canopy-wave.notes: Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list. Recorded from a web-search summary; structured outputs and tool calling shown in examples.

unsupportedOpenAIParams: Responses API on models other than @cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b
cloudflare.notes: Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list. Endpoints: /chat/completions (most text models), /embeddings, /responses (gpt-oss only). Model ids use the @cf/ prefix.

friendli.notes: Served by friendli.ai/docs. Server https://api.friendli.ai. Streaming variants appear as separate "#stream" path keys (e.g. /serverless/v1/chat/completions#stream), a Mintlify convention, not real URLs.

gmicloud.streamUsage: Page says streaming responses include usage stats in the final chunk (no opt-in mentioned).
gmicloud.notes: Only {"type": "json_object"} response_format shown. tool_choice not listed. "Parameter support varies by model". max_tokens stated range "1-128" contradicts default 2000.

inception.notes: Served by docs.inceptionlabs.ai. Server https://api.inceptionlabs.ai. (docs.inceptionlabs.ai/api-reference/openapi.json is an unrelated Mintlify sample.)

inflection.notes: Official developer docs (developers.inflection.ai) were unreachable. Cookbook says an OpenAI-spec API was released in early 2025; legacy /external/api/inference uses {context:[{text,type}], config}. Treat as unverified.

io-net.notes: Single-operation spec referenced by the Mintlify page https://io.net/docs/reference/ai-models/create-chat-completion. Server https://api.intelligence.io.solutions.

ionrouter.notes: Recorded from a web-search summary of ionrouter.io/docs (not fetched directly).

longcat.notes: Recorded from a web-search summary of the official page. temperature range 0-1; messages content text-only; tools/stop/penalties/response_format not listed.

meta.notes: Llama API Stainless spec from meta-llama/llama-api-typescript .stats.yml (last updated 2025-10-01, likely stale). Spec server is http://api.llama.com while the Phaseo gateway config uses https://api.meta.ai - confirm which API the provider id targets.

modelscope.notes: No official API-Inference parameter reference found; only third-party guides confirm the OpenAI-compatible base URL (and Anthropic-compatible at https://api-inference.modelscope.cn). enable_thinking handling unconfirmed.

morpheus.notes: FastAPI spec from the Morpheus API Gateway (v1.50.0). Base https://api.mor.org.

nebius-token-factory.notes: Served live by the API host (same file at api.studio.nebius.com). Title "Nebius OpenAI-compatible inference API", version 20261015.

ovhcloud.notes: Served by the unified AI Endpoints host (title "OpenAI Compatible API" 0.3.11). Per-model hosts may expose their own specs.

parasail.notes: tool_choice: auto (default), required, none, or a specific tool. /v1/responses available on serverless. Python example uses max_completion_tokens though the table lists max_tokens.

poolside.notes: Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list. Recorded from a web-search summary. Responses include reasoning_content; docs ask clients to send prior reasoning_content back. A third-party profile mentions an OpenAPI at https://api.poolsi.de/openai/openapi.json for self-hosted deployments (not checked).

reka.notes: Listed on https://docs.reka.ai/openapi.json (an HTML index, not a spec). Server https://api.reka.ai/v1. A second spec (openapi/api-reference-2.json) is the Vision Agent API.

relace.notes: Served by docs.relace.ai. Servers https://models.relace.ai (models) and https://api.relace.run (infra).

sakana.notes: Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list. Recorded from a web-search summary. Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages supported; docs recommend Responses.

streamlake.notes: Only a coding-tool integration guide found (search summary). No parameter reference.

tensorix.streamUsage: Not documented (example chunks have no usage).
tensorix.notes: Only json_object response_format shown; tool_choice not documented; reasoning params on a separate page; reasoning appears in reasoning_content.

upstage.streamUsage: Not documented (stream_options attributes collapsed on the page).
upstage.notes: Reasoning text in choices[].message.reasoning / delta.reasoning. response_format json_object (conversation must contain "JSON") or json_schema (strict true, additionalProperties false, all properties required). tool_choice none|auto|required|named. frequency_penalty default 1.1. n, stop, seed, logprobs, user absent from the page.

venice.notes: Served by the API host. Base https://api.venice.ai/api/v1.

unsupportedOpenAIParams: Unknown fields are not rejected but may have no effect
GLM-5.2 ignores temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty
wafer.streamUsage: Always sent on successful streams in a final chunk with empty choices before [DONE]; stream_options not needed.
wafer.notes: reasoning_effort none|low|medium|high|xhigh|max. tool_choice auto|none|required|named. If both max_tokens and max_completion_tokens are sent, max_tokens wins. Unsupported JSON-schema keywords are dropped from the constraint.

weights-and-biases.notes: docs.wandb.ai inference pages redirect to docs.coreweave.com. Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list.

openrouter.notes: Served by openrouter.ai (YAML twin at /openapi.yaml). Base https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

chutes.notes: Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list. Recorded from a web-search summary; tools, JSON mode and structured outputs claimed supported.

unsupportedOpenAIParams: reasoning_effort has no effect on DeepSeek-V4-Pro (support article); thinking param rejected by the proxy
crusoe.notes: Recorded from a web-search summary. vLLM-backed. The Intelligence Foundry swagger (https://api.intelligence.crusoecloud.com/v1/swagger.json, Swagger 2.0) covers files/batches/fine-tuning only, and docs.crusoe.ai/openapi.json is the cloud management API; neither has chat.

hyperbolic.notes: Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list. Recorded from a web-search summary. https://www.hyperbolic.ai/docs/api-reference/openapi.json exists (verified OpenAPI 3.1.0) but covers the GPU/storage marketplace only, no chat paths.

featherless.notes: stream, n, logprobs, logit_bias, tools, user are absent from this page (tool calling on a separate page). seed "not reliable". Asks for HTTP-Referer and X-Title headers.

mancer.notes: No parameter reference found (search summary). Docs describe text-generation-webui-style sampling and an X-API-KEY header; /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions exist per the models page.

infermatic.notes: Recorded from a web-search summary. Models without a chat template are rejected on /v1/chat/completions.

nvidia.streamUsage: Not documented on the index page.
nvidia.notes: Index page lists models and links per-model "-infer" reference pages (each likely carries its own OpenAPI on the ReadMe site); no global spec download found. Parameters vary per model.

scaleway.notes: "Download schema" link on the API reference. Server https://api.scaleway.ai; project_id path segment is optional in practice (examples use https://api.scaleway.ai/v1/chat/completions). curl on this machine failed the TLS chain for scaleway.com; fetched with Node.

thinking-machines.notes: Recorded from a web-search summary. Docs describe OpenAI Completions compatibility (beta); chat completions also served per a tinker-cookbook issue (#684: reasoning returned inline in content, reasoning_content always None). model is a tinker:// sampler weight path or a base model name.

darkbloom.streamUsage: Not documented; a final stream event may carry se_signature/response_hash with empty choices.
darkbloom.notes: Claims full OpenAI compatibility but documents no tools or response_format. max_tokens defaults to 8192 if omitted. /v1/responses is an alias auto-detected by input vs messages. Attestation response headers (X-Provider-*).

doubleword.notes: Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list. Recorded from a web-search summary.

mara.notes: Page says OpenAI-compatible; no full parameter list. Only the dashboard landing page found (search summary); its Python example uses the SambaNova SDK, suggesting (unconfirmed) a SambaNova-compatible backend.

inference-net.notes: Page says "Streaming, structured outputs, and the other chat completions features work" with the OpenAI-compatible API; no parameter list.

tencent-cloud.streamUsage: stream_options.include_usage=true returns usage in the stream (details not given).
tencent-cloud.notes: Recorded from a web-search summary of the Hy/GLM/DeepSeek API guides. Integration PDF has a typo host "tokenhubintl".

unsupportedOpenAIParams: max_tokens rejected by newer OpenAI reasoning models (use max_completion_tokens)
phala.notes: tool_choice auto|none|specific. Receipt headers x-receipt-id, x-aci-identity, x-aci-keyset-digest. Responses and Messages pages also exist (not reviewed).

qwen.notes: No separate "qwen" provider folder exists in apps/api/src/providers; Qwen's first-party API is Alibaba Model Studio. Use the alibaba-cloud entry.
